title: `voids/embodiment-cognitive-limits` L43 "Neuropsychological cases demonstrate the dissociation": both cases it cites run the same way (description intact, action impaired), so they do not show a double dissociation; the converse case (visual form agnosia, patient DF) is what Milner & Goodale actually pair with optic ataxia; check the Merleau-Ponty ch. 3 attribution (the Schneider case)
